source.name: Mantos do Futebol: Camisa titular do Sporting Braga 2026-2027 é revelada pela PUMA
source.quote: O patrocínio máster “Solverde.pt” está centralizado na parte frontal, enquanto os patrocinadores “amco” e “Lusíadas” aparecem na parte traseira da camisa.
source.note: Main sponsor across the front of the 2026-27 home shirt. The deal (ECO, 14 July 2025, https://eco.sapo.pt/2025/07/14/solverde-e-sc-braga-assinam-contrato-marca-de-apostas-e-agora-main-sponsor-do-clube-minhoto/) puts Solverde.pt on the front of the first team's shirts for three seasons from 2025-26; the club shop's product photo (https://shop.scbraga.pt/products/26-27-sc-braga-home-jersey-puma-red-puma) shows SOLVERDE.PT across the front.

source.name: A Bola: SC Braga reforça parceria por mais dois anos
source.quote: Guerreiros do Minho assinam novo protocolo com a 'Tek4life' que agora vai ter o seu nome nas camisolas da equipa principal; novo acordo estende-se até 2027
source.note: The same article says the name goes on the sleeves ('O nome vai aparecer nas mangas das indumentárias de jogo destas três turmas'); the deal runs to 2027, covering 2026-27, and the club shop's product photo (https://shop.scbraga.pt/products/26-27-sc-braga-home-jersey-puma-red-puma) shows tek4life on the sleeve.

source.name: SABSEG: SC Braga e SABSEG reforçam parceria até 2028
source.quote: Este acordo pressupõe o patrocínio da frente do calção das equipas A, B e Sub-23, bem como de outros ativos presentes no Estádio Municipal de Braga.
source.note: Front of the shorts under a contract that runs to 2028, so it covers 2026-27. The page is undated; ECO Seguros reported the renewal on 15 June 2025.

source.name: Footy Headlines: Braga 26-27 Home Kit Released
source.quote: This is the new Puma SC Braga home shirt for 2026-27.
source.note: Kit maker, not a shirt sponsor in the front/back/sleeve sense.

summary: Puma-made home shirt, launched on 29 June 2026, with Solverde.pt (Grupo Solverde) across the front, amco and Lusíadas on the back, Tek4life on the sleeves and SABSEG on the front of the shorts. Not marked complete: the club shop's product photo (https://shop.scbraga.pt/products/26-27-sc-braga-home-jersey-puma-red-puma) also shows soleo above the Puma logo on the front, which no page text documents for 2026-27 (the last announced Soleo renewal was for 2025/26), and no source lists every sponsor on the shorts. Qatar Sports Investments agreed in 2022 to buy 21.67% of the club's share capital (qsi-braga-stake).
